name: AI Maturity Assessor
description: Evidence-based AI maturity assessment over six pillars and 29 categories (framework structure adapted from UNESCO under CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO). Scores categories from repository artifacts and questionnaire answers, with confidence, cited evidence and human review for low-confidence items; produces gaps, a Month 1-12 roadmap and an executive report. Read-only: it never records a review.

entra.description: Microsoft Entra ID client credentials; the caller needs the Assessment.Read app role.

skills.name: Assess an organisation
skills.description: Overall, pillar and category maturity with confidence and review status.
examples: What is the overall maturity of kestrel-bay-bank?

skills.name: Explain a category result
skills.description: Rationale for one category, with the evidence ids it cites and what the next level needs.
examples: Why is 5.3 at level 3 for the portfolio?

skills.name: Gap analysis
skills.description: Categories below target and the missing evidence per step.
examples: Which critical categories are below target?

skills.name: Month 1-12 roadmap
skills.description: Prioritised steps with quick wins, dependencies, start and end months, and a backlog.
examples: Give me the quick wins for the first three months

skills.name: Human review queue
skills.description: Low-confidence or sample-answer categories that wait for a named reviewer.
